<!-- key: cli:accept -->
### puzzle accept

apply a proposal.

`puzzle accept [-h] [--only ONLY] project proposal`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `proposal` |   |
| `--only` | comma-separated command numbers, e.g. 0,2 |

<!-- key: cli:adapt -->
### puzzle adapt

mesh again from the error estimate, pass after pass, until it is at a target (ADR 0066).

`puzzle adapt [-h] [--target T] [--budget N] [--max-elements N] [--anisotropic] [--delete-passes] [--points] [--json] project study`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `study` |   |
| `--target` | the error to reach (0.02 = 2 %%) |
| `--budget` | at most N passes |
| `--max-elements` | stop past N elements |
| `--anisotropic` | remesh with MMG along the field's Hessian (stretched elements) |
| `--delete-passes` | delete the earlier passes' runs at the end (their table is kept) |
| `--points` | read the passes run; solve nothing |
| `--json` | the passes as JSON |

<!-- key: cli:advise -->
### puzzle advise

what the project needs next (the Advisor, ADR 0040).

`puzzle advise [-h] [--component COMPONENT] [--study STUDY] project`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `--component` | a component's name (default: the first) |
| `--study` | a study's name (default: the component's first) |

<!-- key: cli:agent -->
### puzzle agent

choose the local expert model by measurement (ADR 0022).

`puzzle agent [-h] [--base-url BASE_URL] [--model MODEL] [--again] [--use] [--remote] [--budget BUDGET] [--workdir WORKDIR] {pick}`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `action` |   |
| `--base-url` | the local endpoint (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio) |
| `--model` | only these models (repeatable) |
| `--again` | measure again, ignoring kept results |
| `--use` | save the recommendation in agent.toml |
| `--remote` | measure the enabled remote providers' tool-calling models instead (opt-in; needs --budget) |
| `--budget` | --remote: the most model requests in all |
| `--workdir` | where the task projects go (default: a temp) |

<!-- key: cli:agent-key -->
### puzzle agent-key

store, check or remove a model provider's API key.

`puzzle agent-key [-h] [--provider PROVIDER] {set,check,remove,status,clear}`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `action` | check: one cheap call with the key; status: where it comes from |
| `--provider` | a provider id (anthropic, openai, google, huggingface, thinking_machines, meta, nvidia, local) or compatible:NAME |

| `project` |   |
| `file` | the archive to write (.puzzle) |
| `--results` | which runs go in: none, the latest per study (default), all |
| `--no-versions` | leave the versions out |
| `--no-history` | leave the history out |

<!-- key: cli:convergence -->
### puzzle convergence

a study on finer and finer meshes, judged by the grid convergence index (ADR 0066).

`puzzle convergence [-h] [--levels N] [--ratio R] [--target T] [--points] [--json] project study`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `study` | the study, or a mesh study |
| `--levels` | how many meshes (default 3) |
| `--ratio` | each mesh's sizes over the next |
| `--target` | the GCI that counts as converged |
| `--points` | read the meshes run; solve nothing |
| `--json` | levels and verdicts as JSON |

<!-- key: cli:elements -->
### puzzle elements

every solver's elements, grouped (ADR 0082).

`puzzle elements [-h] [--solver SOLVER] [--family FAMILY] [--study STUDY]`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `--solver` | calculix, code_aster, elmer, fenicsx, pynite... |
| `--family` | solid_3d, solid_2d, shell, beam, truss, discrete, thermal, electromagnetic, fluid |
| `--study` | static, modal, buckling, transient, harmonic, contact, plasticity, large_deflection, heat, electrostatics, magnetics, flow |

<!-- key: cli:error-estimate -->
### puzzle error-estimate

how far a run is from the exact answer, per element (Zienkiewicz–Zhu; ADR 0066).

`puzzle error-estimate [-h] [--field FIELD] [--target T] [--json] project study`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `study` | the study (its newest run) |
| `--field` | a nodal field's gradient jumps instead (relative only) |
| `--target` | the error the refinement ratio is for (default 0.02 = 2 %%) |
| `--json` | the summary as JSON |

<!-- key: cli:export -->
### puzzle export

results for other software: ParaView, point clouds, CAD.

`puzzle export [-h] (--study STUDY | --run RUN) [--format {abaqus_displacement,abaqus_inp,cgns,deformed_step,deformed_stl,ensight,exodus,gltf,lorentz_cloud,morphed_step,nastran,paraview,point_cloud,tecplot,unv,vtkhdf,wall_cloud}] [--step STEP] [--quantity QUANTITY] [--selection SELECTION] [--scale SCALE] [--compensate] [--units {si,display}] [--axes AXES] project output`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `--study` | the study's latest run |
| `--run` | a run id (from `puzzle runs`) |
| `output` | the file to write (its suffix is set) |
| `--format` | paraview: ParaView (.pvd + .vtu); point_cloud: Point cloud (.csv: x, y, z, values); deformed_stl: Deformed shape (.stl); deformed_step: Deformed shape (.step, AP242 tessellated); exodus: Exodus II (.exo); vtkhdf: VTKHDF (.vtkhdf); unv: I-DEAS universal file (.unv); ensight: EnSight Gold (.case); cgns: CGNS (.cgns, HDF5); tecplot: Tecplot ASCII (.dat); wall_cloud: Wall quantities (.csv: x, y, z, values); nastran: Nastran bulk data and punch results (.bdf + .pch); abaqus_inp: Abaqus/CalculiX mesh and temperatures (.inp); abaqus_displacement: Abaqus/CalculiX mesh and displacements as *BOUNDARY (.inp); gltf: glTF 3D picture (.glb); lorentz_cloud: Lorentz force density J × B (.csv point cloud); morphed_step: Deformed shape (.step, morphed CAD) |
| `--step` | which step (0 first, -1 last) |
| `--quantity` | point cloud: a result key, e.g. stress:von_mises |
| `--selection` | point cloud: only this selection's nodes |
| `--scale` | deformed shape: exaggeration |
| `--compensate` | deformed shape: moved by -u instead |
| `--units` |   |
| `--axes` | a coordinate system: components in its axes |

<!-- key: cli:import-field -->
### puzzle import-field

bring in values at points from a file (ADR 0044).

`puzzle import-field [-h] [--name NAME] [--unit UNIT] [--column NAME:ROLE[:UNIT]] [--region REGION] [--step STEP] [--every-step] [--times S [S ...]] [--frequencies HZ [HZ ...]] [--translate X Y Z] [--rotate RX RY RZ] [--about X Y Z] project file [file ...]`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `file` | CSV/TXT/DAT (x, y, z and values), VTU, a Fluent profile (.prof), Exodus II (.exo, .e), EnSight Gold (.case) or an OpenFOAM case folder; several files (one per time) with --times |
| `--name` | the field's name (default: the file's) |
| `--unit` | the points' length unit (default: from the header, else m) |
| `--column` | a column's role (x, y, z, value, time, frequency, ignore) and unit, e.g. p:value:MPa |
| `--region` | a block, node set, part, patch or profile of the source |
| `--step` | the source's step to read (Exodus/EnSight number from 1, OpenFOAM time directory; default the last) |
| `--every-step` | vary in time over every step of the source (Exodus, EnSight, OpenFOAM) |
| `--times` | seconds: one per file, or per step with --every-step |
| `--frequencies` | in place of --times: the field varies with frequency (Hz), for harmonic steps |
| `--translate` | metres |
| `--rotate` | degrees |
| `--about` | metres |

<!-- key: cli:jobs -->
### puzzle jobs

solves with a job runner, not yet home (ADR 0067): list, resume, cancel or dismiss them.

`puzzle jobs [-h] [--live] [--json] [--resume [JOB|STUDY|all] | --cancel JOB|STUDY | --dismiss JOB|STUDY] [--delete-remote] [-v] project`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `--live` | ask remote hosts too (over SSH) |
| `--json` |   |
| `--resume` | pick a job up and bring its results home (default: all of them, finished ones first) |
| `--cancel` | stop a job (it stays listed) |
| `--dismiss` | forget a job without its results (cancelled first if it runs) |
| `--delete-remote` | with --dismiss: delete the case on the remote host too |
| `-v, --verbose` | with --resume: print the solver's log |

<!-- key: cli:log -->
### puzzle log

a run's whole solver logs: search them, or the problems.

`puzzle log [-h] (--study STUDY | --run RUN) [--grep GREP] [--problems] [--context CONTEXT] [--tail TAIL] [--files] project`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `--study` | the study's newest attempt (a failed one too) |
| `--run` | a stored run id (from `puzzle runs`) |
| `--grep` | lines matching this regular expression (any case) |
| `--problems` | errors and warnings only |
| `--context` | lines around each match |
| `--tail` | without a filter: each file's last N |
| `--files` | list the log files and counts only |

<!-- key: cli:machine -->
### puzzle machine

Puzzle's Linux machine on Windows: WSL 2 solvers (ADR 0068 step 5).

`puzzle machine [-h] [--image IMAGE] [--tarball TARBALL] {list,install,remove} [solver]`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `action` |   |
| `solver` | install/remove: elmer, openfoam, code_saturne, ... |
| `--image` | install: the image to export (default: the solver's) |
| `--tarball` | install: a root file system to import instead |

### puzzle materials-export

<!-- key: cli:materials-import -->
### puzzle materials-import

materials from a library file into yours.

`puzzle materials-import [-h] [--into {yours,library}] [--replace] path`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | a file from materials-export, or a library.json |
| `--into` | yours (default): added to your materials, checked, one undo; library: replaces your imported library (the old one kept as .bak) |
| `--replace` | replace materials you already have (default: keep them) |

<!-- key: cli:materials-remove -->
### puzzle materials-remove

`puzzle materials-remove [-h] [--restore] [--list] [keys ...]`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `keys` | library keys (materials-duplicates lists some) |
| `--restore` | bring removed ones back instead |
| `--list` | the materials you removed |

`puzzle solvers [-h] [--build] [--repair ENV] [--clear-wait] [--json]`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `--build` | build CalculiX with PARDISO on this computer now (ADR 0051) |
| `--repair` | reinstall a solver environment of the installed app from its package list (calculix, fenicsx, ...) |
| `--clear-wait` | clear the PARDISO build's 24-hour wait after a failure, so it is tried the next time Puzzle opens (Settings > Advanced) |
| `--json` |   |

<!-- key: cli:split-parts -->
### puzzle split-parts

one part per body of a part holding several (an imported assembly).

`puzzle split-parts [-h] [--no-bond] [--dry-run] project component part`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `component` | the component's name |
| `part` | the part to split |
| `--no-bond` | don't add bonded contacts where the bodies touch |
| `--dry-run` | say what it would make, change nothing |

<!-- key: cli:table -->
### puzzle table

a table operator's rows (ADR 0064), in display units.

`puzzle table [-h] [--rows N] [--csv FILE] [--parquet FILE] [--xlsx FILE] project name`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `name` | the operator |
| `--rows` | rows shown (default 20) |
| `--csv` | write it all as CSV |
| `--parquet` | write it all as Parquet |
| `--xlsx` | write it all as Excel |

<!-- key: cli:version-restore -->
### puzzle version-restore

make the project a version's again (the state replaced is kept as a version).

`puzzle version-restore [-h] project version`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `version` | its number, or 'good' for the latest known good |

<!-- key: cli:version-save -->
### puzzle version-save

save a version of the project as it is now.

`puzzle version-save [-h] [--label LABEL] [--note NOTE] [--good] project`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `--label` | a few words naming it |
| `--note` |   |
| `--good` | mark it known good |

<!-- key: cli:versions -->
### puzzle versions

the project's versions, newest first (ADR 0059).

`puzzle versions [-h] [--show N] [--by {you,puzzle,agent}] [--type TYPE] [--since SINCE] [--until UNTIL] [--good] [--search SEARCH] project`

| Argument | What |
| --- | --- |
| `project` |   |
| `--show` | one version's summary in full |
| `--by` | who made them |
| `--type` | user, first, opened, before_run, edits, before_restore, copied (repeat for several) |
| `--since` | from this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or time (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM) |
| `--until` | up to this date or time (a date includes its day) |
| `--good` | known good ones only |
| `--search` | words in the label, note or changes |
